# Test fixtures

| File | What it is | Source | Licence |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `astronaut.jpg` | Official NASA portrait of astronaut Eileen Collins, re-encoded from PNG to JPEG (quality 90, 512×512) | scikit-image test data, `skimage/data/astronaut.png` at tag v0.24.0 | **Public domain** (a work of the US federal government, NASA) |

Why this image: tests need a real, clear, adult face, but this project never uses users' faces, and we will not add anyone's photo without a clear legal basis. A public-domain official portrait that scientific Python libraries already ship as standard test data meets both requirements.
